limitations: Legacy runInterviewTurn writes facts/wrap inline. Activation requires ON-B-05 to bind the existing interviewer through a side-effect-free preparation adapter; it is deliberately not a default implementation.
Pure model inference can repeat after a crash before checkpoint persistence. The durable logical turn and write-attempt identity remain single; exactly-once remote inference is not claimed.
ProfilePort must reconcile durable receipts by attemptId and recheck signal/isCurrent before effects. An in-flight committed fact is not undone by skip.
B11 must preserve legacy completed eligibility, wire authenticated scope/vault bindings, terminal journey acknowledgements and vault Forget/retention policy.
U10 must scope drafts by authenticated account/project/tab, dispose on identity change, map busy/errors/recovery and reconcile transport snapshots.
Records remain one session per actor/project; no reset/re-enrol operation. Corrupt/future records fail closed without deletion.
Actual runtime/UI assembly, real model/profile provider effects and native WebView verification remain blocked.
rollback: Disable/omit interview-session.v1 and use the unchanged legacy path. Preserve additive session records, drafts, confirmed facts and uncertain commit identities. No destructive migration or cleanup.
